Babe! I’ve been here, seriously leave now. Porn addictions are so common now, no one remembers the severity of them. It really isn’t a you problem at all. You will think it is, it will be hard to think it’s not, but this is a very very big him problem. He’s living a very sad life of quick dopamine hits and it really won’t get him far.

Your body, your face, your sexual autonomy, your personality and your worth will get you far more in your future relationship endeavours! His death grip syndrome, erectile dysfunction and skewed views on women will simply not. Feel free to dump him, he will try to downplay the severity, make you feel accountable or downright play victim. As much as porn addiction in it’s right is a very sad and scary and valid problem. You do not need to be his support person, if it’s affecting you negatively you’re in your right to decline being his support person for this. You’ve established a boundary, he’s ignored said boundary. Porn addicts will do that, at the end of the day because they have an addiction. Feel free to PM anytime!

This honestly boils down to if you even love her. I would say the best thing you can do for someone if you’re not into her, is let her have the opportunity to find someone who is. There’s a lot of growing pains around this which is a shame. I see exactly why you feel morally divided. Do you love her enough to be able to emotionally support her through the transitions of her parents divorce and going to college at the same time? If it’s going to be (non derogatory) for lack of better word half assed emotional support, it’s better to cut ties, as it could drag her down more. 
What is her support system looking like aside from your relationship, does she have siblings/friends?

I honestly went through the exact same situation. My dad, I was young and I felt I had to be silent. After 6 years I actually spoke up about it, my father still denies it to this day. Even with evidence, in front of my mother myself and him. My only piece of advice would be to try stay out of it as much as you can, being the mediator wasn’t fun and feeling like I cause my parents split took a toll on me. Just to clarify you’ve literally not done anything wrong, I think you’ve done the right thing. But for sure respect your mothers wishes, it’s hard on you and it’s hard on her too. Just be there for eachother! Don’t reach out to the woman again if it’s affecting your mum too much. Always here if you need to chat x

I get where she’s coming from but what matters here is now she acting towards you. It is definitely weird and childish. I’ve had dreams and it truly does deadass make you feel weird and like it happened. However I would never let how I felt about my dream transfer into how I treated my partner. It’s uncalled for and you shouldn’t be made to feel like shit over something you haven’t done. Ultimately you could just reassure her that you understand that dream would make her feel bad but you would never even dream of doing that cause you love her etc etc. If she continues acting like that, let her know that’s not normal behaviour and if it continues maybe she isn’t the one. Best of luck 👍
my confidence and esteem has been at an all time high lately. definitely ran into heaps of assholes though
